title: Users
subtitle: Who gets in, how, and what they can do. Management reads the plant; a technician writes only his own visits.

action.revokeHint: Removes access to this company; their signature stays on the reports they wrote

metric.fieldHint: sign in with a personal code
metric.withoutCodeHint: technicians who cannot sign in yet

table.title: Company access
table.hintManage: You can change the role and activate or deactivate anyone but yourself.
table.hintRead: Read only: managing users requires the user administration permission.

form.title: Invite to the company
form.hint: Creates the person and their access to this company. The password is set here and they change it later.
form.roleHint: Defines what they can see and touch
form.initialsHint: As they sign the field sheet: HT, CT
form.externalNotice: An external inspector will see the equipment but can only edit the visits they perform, and only while those are open.
form.codeNotice: After creating them, issue their personal code from “Edit”: it is how they sign in on the plant floor.

roles.title: Permissions
roles.subtitle: What each role may view, create, edit and delete, module by module. Permissions are declared by each module on install.
roles.baseHint: Decides whether it can alter field data, and whose. Permissions decide which screens it sees.

edit.title: Edit {{name}}
edit.hint: Profile, password and how far they reach inside the plant.
edit.newPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep it. At least {{count}} characters.
edit.scopeHint: With none ticked they see the whole plant. Ticking some restricts them to those.
edit.ownRole: You cannot change your own role

behaviour.client_viewer: Sees the whole plant and cannot alter any field data.
behaviour.planner: Can move the plan (reschedule orders); cannot alter any field data.
behaviour.technician: Records readings and activities only on visits he is part of, and only while they are open.
behaviour.external_inspector: Contractor: sees the asset and writes only his own visit while it is open.
behaviour.engineer: Corrects and closes any visit in scope; signs reports.
behaviour.company_admin: Runs the company: users, roles and any visit in scope.

profiles.title: Access profiles
profiles.hint: The plant's access matrix. Pick a profile to see its people.

code.title: Access code
code.onlyOnce: Write it down now: it will not be shown again. If lost, issue another.
code.hint: The technician signs in with this code instead of e-mail and password. Issuing a new one invalidates the old.

panel.title: What {{name}} can do
panel.hint: Effective permissions of their role, grouped by module.

audit.title: Audit
audit.subtitle: Who changed what, and when. Nothing here can be edited.
audit.readOnly: Read only: an audit you can edit audits nothing.
audit.emptyHint: Recorded and corrected readings, access changes and code sign-ins show up here.
